EditTextPreference.android:summary: Shown instead of your wallet address and device addresses in every log, trace and screen. Stored only on this phone.

MultiSelectListPreference.android:title: Never exit through
MultiSelectListPreference.android:summary: Countries whose relays must not be your exit. Tap to choose from the relays currently known.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Connect on open
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Start the tunnel when the app opens. For always-on, enable Sailnet in Android VPN settings.

EditTextPreference.android:title: RPC endpoint
EditTextPreference.android:summary: Endpoint the app asks first. Default is Sailnet's own (https://www.sailnet.space/node/api); you can point it at rpc.nano.to or your own node. Public fallbacks are used when it fails.

EditTextPreference.android:title: RPC key
EditTextPreference.android:summary: Only if the endpoint above is rpc.nano.to: its API key, sent to that host only.

EditTextPreference.android:title: Extra bridge lines
EditTextPreference.android:summary: Unlisted relays handed to you privately, one sail-bridge line per row. Bridges are preferred as entry.

EditTextPreference.android:title: DNS resolver at the exit
EditTextPreference.android:summary: Where the exit sends your name lookups. Default 1.1.1.1:53.

EditTextPreference.android:title: Prepaid per circuit (XNO)
EditTextPreference.android:summary: Sent to the entry relay when a circuit is opened. Default 0.0005, about 25 MB.

EditTextPreference.android:title: Maximum price (XNO per MB)
EditTextPreference.android:summary: Relays asking more are not used. Default 0.00005.
